item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 30/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A band of clouds will cover the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure over central China is expected to develop into a cold front gradually during the weekend, and move across the coast of southern China on Sunday and Monday. It will bring showers and squally thunderstorms to the region. The associated northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather to the region. A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week.
